sources.title: Target Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Earnings

scenes.title: Target sells ads too
scenes.sub: And that side is growing fast.

lines.say: Target sells clothes, snacks and toys. It also sells ads.
lines.show: Target sells clothes, snacks and toys. It also sells ads.

lines.say: And that side of the business is growing fast.
lines.show: And that side of the business is growing fast.

lines.say: In its latest quarter, Target's sales grew seven point one percent.
lines.show: In its latest quarter, Target's sales grew 7.1%.

lines.say: Traffic rose five percent. More people are showing up.
lines.show: Traffic rose 5%. More people are showing up.

scenes.heading: What grew fastest
scenes.source: Growth vs. a year earlier, as Target reported, Q3 2026

lines.say: Its toys and fun category jumped nearly twenty seven percent, with record Pokémon sales.
lines.show: Its toys and fun category jumped nearly 27%, with record Pokémon sales.

lines.say: Ads, credit cards and memberships grew nearly twenty percent.
lines.show: Ads, credit cards and memberships grew nearly 20%.

scenes.label: of the U.S. can get it
scenes.note: Same-day services drive 2/3 of Target's digital business

lines.say: Same-day delivery now reaches eighty percent of the U.S. population.
lines.show: Same-day delivery now reaches 80% of the U.S. population.

lines.say: And same-day services drive two thirds of Target's online business.
lines.show: And same-day services drive two-thirds of Target's online business.

lines.say: For the holidays, it added more than eight thousand new gifts, and most cost twenty dollars or less.
lines.show: For the holidays, it added more than 8,000 new gifts, and most cost $20 or less.

scenes.takeaway: Stores bring you in. Ads and memberships add more.

lines.say: Follow H Flick for more money facts like this.
lines.show: Follow HFLIC for more money facts like this.

lines.say: And send this to the friend who never leaves Target with just one thing.
